title: Grilled Korean Eggplant with Crunchy Queso
description: A sweet and spicy twist on classic grilled eggplant, topped with a crispy queso crunch. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy dinner or as a side for your favorite Korean dishes.
instructions: 2. Brush eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt, Korean chili flakes, and brown sugar.
3. Grill eggplant slices for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender and slightly charred.
4. In a small bowl, mix together soy sauce and 1 tbsp of olive oil.
5. Brush the soy sauce mixture onto the grilled eggplant slices.
6. Top each eggplant slice with queso crumbles.
